user.title: Add-on Mount Guard
user.description: Watches the network storage used by your add-ons. Add-ons to watch are added afterwards, one at a time.

data_description.scan_interval: The Supervisor already reports failures; this poll is a safety net for when it reports a mount as active that Home Assistant cannot see.
data_description.retry_interval: How long to wait before retrying a failed repair. A NAS that is rebooting answers on the network before it has finished exporting its shares.
data_description.min_free_ratio: Below this, the add-ons using the mount are stopped to protect the installation. 0 disables this safeguard.
data_description.notify: Creates a Home Assistant notification on a failure or an emergency stop.

error.no_supervisor: Supervisor not found. This integration requires Home Assistant OS or Supervised.

abort.already_configured: Add-on Mount Guard is already configured.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one instance of Add-on Mount Guard is allowed.

addon.title: Add-on to watch
addon.description: Pick the add-on whose writes should be protected.

mounts.title: Mounts used by this add-on
mounts.description: The settings below belong to the mount, not to the add-on: a second add-on declaring the same mounts will find them unchanged.

data_description.host: Probed with a TCP connection on the share's port to tell when the NAS is back.
data_description.mode: "Local fallback" lets the add-on write locally and moves the files back afterwards. "Stop only" stops the add-on and moves nothing.
data_description.overwrite: What to do with a file that exists on both sides when moving files back.
data_description.concurrency: A network share answers in milliseconds: moving thousands of small files back spends its time waiting. Several copies at once wait in parallel. Lower it if the NAS refuses concurrent connections.

abort.no_addons: Every installed add-on is already watched.
abort.no_mounts: No network storage under /media or /share is configured in Settings > System > Storage.

repair.name: Repair now
repair.description: Runs the repair sequence without waiting for the retry delay.

mount.name: Mount
mount.description: Network storage name. With no target, every watched mount.

addon.name: Add-on
addon.description: Add-on slug: all of its mounts are handled.

cancel.name: Cancel
cancel.description: Abandons the running remediation. Takes effect between two steps, never in the middle of a copy.

addon.name: Add-on
addon.description: Add-on slug: all of its mounts are handled.

set_mode.name: Change mode
set_mode.description: Changes what happens to a mount when it fails.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Local fallback then move back, or stop only.

repair_failed.title: Cannot repair: {mount}
repair_failed.description:
Repairing mount "{mount}" failed three times in a row. Last error: {error}

Check that the NAS is reachable and that the storage is configured correctly under Settings > System > Storage.
